question: 单项选择：I _____ TV at 8 o'clock last night. A. watch  B. watched  C. was watching  D. am watching
answer: 答案：C. was watching。解析：at 8 o'clock last night是过去某一点时间，"正在做"用过去进行时。整句：I was watching TV at 8 o'clock last night.

question: 单项选择：They _____ basketball at that time yesterday. A. play  B. played  C. were playing  D. are playing
answer: 答案：C. were playing。解析：at that time yesterday是过去某时，"正在做"用过去进行时。主语they用were。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：She ______ (read) a book when I called her last night.
answer: 答案：was reading。解析：when I called是过去时，主句用过去进行时。完整：She was reading a book when I called her last night.

question: 单项选择：What _____ you _____ at this time yesterday? A. are, doing  B. were, doing  C. did, do  D. was, doing
answer: 答案：B. were, doing。解析：at this time yesterday是过去某时，特殊疑问句用were + 主语 + doing。

question: 翻译句子：昨天晚上这个时候我在做作业。
answer: 答案：I was doing my homework at this time last night. 解析：at this time last night是过去某时，was doing是过去进行时。

question: 单项选择：At 9 last night, I _____ dinner with my family. A. have  B. had  C. was having  D. am having
answer: 答案：C. was having。解析：at 9 last night是过去某时，"正在吃"用过去进行时。整句：At 9 last night, I was having dinner with my family.

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：They ______ (run) in the park at 5 yesterday afternoon.
answer: 答案：were running。解析：at 5 yesterday afternoon是过去某时。主语they用were。完整：They were running in the park at 5 yesterday afternoon.

question: 单项选择：While I _____ the dishes, the doorbell rang. A. wash  B. washed  C. was washing  D. am washing
answer: 答案：C. was washing。解析：while + 延续性动作，用过去进行时。整句：While I was washing the dishes, the doorbell rang.

question: 翻译句子：昨天下午三点他们在踢足球。
answer: 答案：They were playing football at three yesterday afternoon. 解析：at three yesterday afternoon是过去某时。

question: 单项选择：The children _____ in the garden when it began to rain. A. play  B. played  C. were playing  D. are playing
answer: 答案：C. were playing。解析：when it began to rain是一般过去时，主句用过去进行时。整句：The children were playing in the garden when it began to rain.
